q: In n8n, data travels between nodes as…
options: A list of items, each a JSON object
explain: Every node receives and returns items shaped like { json: {...} }.

q: A node receives 100 items. By default how many times does it run?
explain: Most nodes run once per item. Use Aggregate or a Code node in all-items mode to work on the whole list.

q: Which expression reads the 'name' field of the current item?
explain: $json is the current item's data inside {{ }} expressions.

q: The Webhook TEST URL only works when…
options: You click 'Listen for test event' in the editor
explain: The production URL needs the workflow to be Active; the test URL needs the editor to be listening.

q: Which node has TRUE and FALSE outputs?
explain: IF splits items into two outputs; Switch handles more than two paths.

q: What does a Respond to Webhook node let you do?
options: Return your own answer to the caller of the webhook
explain: It sends the HTTP response, turning a workflow into a small API that returns its result to the caller.

q: Where should an API key live?
explain: Credentials are stored encrypted with N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY and are not exported with the workflow.

q: A scheduled workflow does not run. Most likely cause?
explain: Triggers like Schedule and Webhook (production) only run for Active workflows.

q: How do you get notified when any production workflow fails?
options: Create an Error Workflow starting with an Error Trigger and select it in the workflow settings
explain: The error workflow runs whenever a production execution of the linked workflow fails.

options: A main instance queues jobs in Redis and separate workers execute them
explain: Queue mode (EXECUTIONS_MODE=queue) scales n8n with Redis, Postgres and worker processes.

q: Why use PostgreSQL instead of the default SQLite for production?
options: It is required by the license
Better concurrency, backups and scale with many executions
It makes workflows faster to design
explain: Postgres handles many executions and is easier to back up and scale.

q: What happens if you lose N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY after creating credentials?
explain: The key encrypts credentials; back it up separately from the database.
